This one stands in for a note that several other pages reference — the kind of page that makes a wiki more useful than a pile of separate documents.

Both [Example Project](example-project.qmd) and [Related Topic](related-topic.qmd) point here.

## Categories

This page's front matter lists two categories (`placeholder`, `methods`) rather than one.
Because `categories: true` is set on the Projects listing, they become clickable filters on the index page.
A second, lighter way to group pages alongside the sidebar.

## Math

Inline math like $\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$ works out of the box, as do display equations:

$$
\hat{\beta} = (X^\top X)^{-1} X^\top y
$$

No configuration needed — MathJax is included automatically when a page contains math.
